CustomField.description: Order-side mirror of QuoteLineItem.RLM_Approval_Level_Calc__c (0 none, 1 Manager, 2 Director, 3 VP). Bound in OrderEntitiesMapping so RLM_DefaultPricingProcedure, including its approval-flags overlay, can price Orders (for example getRenewableAssetsSummary in the renewal flow). Written by the overlay on every reprice; read-only for users.
CustomField.label: Approval Level Calc
